children: TTM Technologies completed a private offering of $500 million 6.750% senior notes due 2034 to support the pending acquisition of EDS Intermediate Holding and for general corporate purposes, including potential revolver reduction. The notes, guaranteed on a senior unsecured basis by certain subsidiaries, pay interest semi-annually starting April 1, 2027. The indenture includes customary covenants, change-of-control and asset sale repurchase provisions, and a special mandatory redemption if the EDS acquisition does not close by the stated outside date.
: Private offering of 6.750% senior unsecured notes due 2034 (Indenture)
: U.S. Bank Trust Company, as Trustee, and noteholders
: Fund EDS acquisition and general corporate purposes
